findings: Stage 13 exact script assembly must add adaptive.phase_terminal_rules.mixed_practice. The required mixed_practice namespace is present in execution_sequence, completion_thresholds, teacher-turn accounting, overall_mastery, replay reset, and FINISH eligibility, but is absent from phase_terminal_rules; therefore the initial and replay mixed paths have no explicit terminal success/failure/stop contract. Repair only the assembly/runtime control at Stage 13 by adding a mixed_practice terminal rule that emits and scores all 20 frozen items, succeeds at 16_of_20, fails below 16_of_20, and stops after item 20 or any alarm.

Stage 13 exact script assembly must make adaptive.train_longer.stop_rule deterministic. 'Stop at independent 0.8 success on the additional order' supplies no minimum denominator or evaluation checkpoint, so it can be interpreted as stopping after one correct item and does not waterproof the frozen eight-item intervention. Repair the Stage 13 runtime control by naming the exact evaluation denominator/checkpoint and integer success condition, while retaining the frozen ordered IDs, eight-item cap, single-use limit, and defer_and_revisit exhaustion.

Stage 13 exact script assembly exposes an earlier review outcome through source_bindings role accepted_static_review, contrary to the fresh anonymous static-review boundary. Remove every prior static-review binding and outcome-bearing label from the anonymous candidate handed to Stage 13A; retain only accepted upstream authoring, pixel, policy, and selection artifacts needed to audit this candidate.
